title: Verified Query Line Schema
description: JSON Schema for a single line in verified_queries.jsonl

id.description: Unique verified query identifier, e.g. vq_orders_gmv_001

question.description: The natural language question that triggers this query

modelRef.description: Reference to the domain model this query belongs to, e.g. orders

hitCount.description: Number of times this query has been reused

lastHit.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent hit

confirmedBy.description: Who confirmed this query (user name or 'ai')

stale.description: Marked true when referenced schema objects no longer exist
